name: Thailand
lede: Five nights in Bangkok together, in from Hanoi, working nights and out from midday. Then Os heads north to Chiang Mai, and two days on the water out of Khao Lak before Manila.
blurb: Five nights in Bangkok together, then Os north to Chiang Mai and two days on the water out of Khao Lak before Manila.
description: Bangkok together, then Os on to Chiang Mai and the Similans. The days, the dives, and what to book first.
